title: Pure Chtonian Infernal
summary: Pure Chtonian Infernal beatdown and burn strategy inspired by Chazz Princeton and Zane Truesdale's GX-era Fire and Dark monsters. Built around Chthonian Emperor Dragon, Chthonian Soldier, and Infernal Incinerator, the deck utilizes Gemini mechanics, damage reflection, and aggressive tribute summons to punish high-ATK bosses and steal enemy Extra Deck monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Evil HERO Infernal Prodigy Special Summons itself from hand when you control no monsters, and draws a card during the End Phase if tributed for a Tribute Summon.
Catalyst Field allows Level 6 Chthonian Emperor Dragon to be Normal Summoned without Tributing and grants an extra Normal Summon to immediately unlock its Gemini double attack.
Chthonian Soldier reflects battle damage back onto the opponent whenever it is destroyed by battle, turning opposing attacks into mutually assured destruction.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Chthonian Soldier or Evil HERO Infernal Prodigy directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Catalyst Field + Chthonian Emperor Dragon
steps: Activate Catalyst Field from your hand.
Normal Summon Chthonian Emperor Dragon without Tributing via Catalyst Field's effect.
Use Catalyst Field's second effect to Normal Summon Chthonian Emperor Dragon a second time, unlocking its Gemini effect to attack twice per Battle Phase.
Equip Supervise to Chthonian Emperor Dragon to provide floating insurance upon removal, or summon Evil HERO Infernal Prodigy as link/tribute fodder.
Set Chthonian Blast or Chthonian Polymer to disrupt the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Chthonian Emperor Dragon boasts 2400 ATK and attacks twice during each Battle Phase once its Gemini effect is active, tearing through opposing monsters.
Infernal Incinerator is a 2800 ATK Level 8 Fiend summoned by tributing a 2000+ ATK monster, gaining 300 ATK for every monster the opponent controls.
Infernal Dragon brings 2000 ATK at Level 4, reviving itself from the GY during the End Phase by tributing a monster if it attacked.
Superalloy Beast Raptinus automatically unlocks Gemini effects across the field, keeping Chthonian Emperor Dragon active without extra Normal Summons.
Infernal Flame Vixen is a Rank 4 Xyz that boosts its ATK to 2700 and banishes up to 3 cards from either GY to disrupt opponent recursion.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Chthonian Polymer is a counter-play Trap that tributes 1 monster you control when the opponent Fusion Summons to permanently take control of that Fusion Monster.
Chthonian Blast destroys the face-up monster with the lowest ATK when your monster is destroyed and burns both players for 500 damage.
Chthonian Alliance equips to a monster to boost its ATK by 800 for every other monster on the field sharing its name, synergizing with multiple Emperor Dragons or Soldiers.
Supervise immediately awakens Gemini effects and Special Summons a Normal or Gemini monster from your GY when sent to the GY.
